body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and end one ordinary defensive benefit worth at most +1 Defense or 1 Damage reduction. Equipment and Specialty Conditions remain.

surges.html: Move a small unattended object in the target's space up to 2 units.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When this target receives another ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that benefit resolves.
